task_instance: Audit a sample 6-opportunity pipeline export (CSV, mimicking a HubSpot/Salesforce export with Amount, Close Date, Next Step, Last Activity Date, Created Date, Contact Roles) for CRM hygiene issues per the skill's Step 2 checks, and produce the Step 4 copy-paste fix checklist (summary, per-opp fix list with cited values, bulk actions) - the 'files-only' tier the skill itself defines for when no CRM connector is available.
evidence: Created /tmp/.../pipeline_export.csv with 6 sample opportunities exercising every check in the skill's table (blank amount, $0 amount, past close dates, stale next steps, stale/no activity, single-threaded and zero-contact opps, one fully clean opp). Manually applied each Step 2 check per row against today's date (2026-09-27, from the session's own date) and wrote the results to /tmp/.../fix_checklist.md, following the skill's Step 4 output shape: Summary (5 critical / 5 attention / 1 clean), a per-opportunity fix list citing the exact field values read plus suggested fixes (flagged as placeholders where they would normally come from live email/docs context that isn't available here), and a Bulk actions section (3 opps need close-date pushes, 2 need amounts filled in, 4 need contact roles added, 5 need fresh next steps). Verified by re-reading fix_checklist.md and cross-checking each flag (e.g. OPP-1001 close date 2026-08-15 is 43 days before 2026-09-27 -> correctly flagged past; OPP-1004 has no flags and is correctly the sole 'clean' opp). No CRM connector, docs connector, or email connector was called or available (none permitted in this runtime for this task), so the audit correctly ran in the skill's own documented 'files-only' tier and explicitly noted which checks that tier must skip (stage-criteria evidence, exact stage-age-vs-median, close-date-changed-since-creation, and real email/docs-grounded next-step suggestions) rather than fabricating those results. No shell/code execution, binary files, or external writes were needed or used.
